subject: executor: refine topn (#51271)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (executor/sortexec only). Change is a refactor: move TopN runtime state (`rowChunks`/`rowPtrs`/output index) into `topNChunkHeap`, and rename `SortExec.compressRow` to `compareRow` with identical comparison semantics. Checked heap invariants (max-heap over “worst” row per ORDER BY), OFFSET/LIMIT handling, and mem-tracker deltas in compaction; no Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found.
